mapper.select: select count(*) as totalCalls, ifnull(sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as answeredCalls, ifnull(sum(case when status = '3' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as missedCalls, ifnull(sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as transferredCalls, ifnull(round(avg(case when status = '1' then duration end), 0), 0) as avgDuration from ai_call_record where call_time >= #{beginTime} and call_time < #{endTime}

select date_format(call_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') as timeLabel, count(*) as totalCalls, ifnull(sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as answeredCalls, ifnull(sum(case when status = '3' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as missedCalls, ifnull(sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as transferredCalls from ai_call_record where call_time >= #{beginTime} and call_time < #{endTime} group by date_format(call_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') order by timeLabel

select ifnull(c.category_name, '未分类') as name, count(*) as value from ai_call_record cr left join ai_consultation_category c on cr.category_id = c.category_id where cr.call_time >= #{beginTime} and cr.call_time < #{endTime} group by c.category_id, c.category_name order by value desc

select count(distinct session_id) as totalSessions, count(distinct case when handoff = '1' then session_id end) as handoffSessions from ai_agent_message where create_time >= #{beginTime} and create_time < #{endTime}

select a.agent_id as agentId, a.agent_name as agentName, a.status, a.call_status as callStatus, ifnull(cr.todayCalls, 0) as todayCalls, ifnull(cr.talkDuration, 0) as talkDuration, ifnull(cr.avgDuration, 0) as avgDuration from ai_call_agent_status a left join ( select agent_id, count(*) as todayCalls, ifnull(sum(duration), 0) as talkDuration, ifnull(round(avg(duration), 0), 0) as avgDuration from ai_call_record where date(call_time) = curdate() group by agent_id ) cr on cr.agent_id = a.agent_id where a.status != '0' order by todayCalls desc, a.agent_id asc

select q.queue_id as queueId, q.caller_number as callerNumber, q.enqueue_time as enqueueTime, q.wait_duration as waitDuration, q.priority, q.group_id as groupId, ifnull(g.group_name, '-') as groupName from ai_call_queue q left join ai_skill_group g on g.group_id = q.group_id where q.queue_status = '0' order by q.priority desc, q.enqueue_time asc

select task_id as taskId, task_name as taskName, status, total_count as totalCount, completed_count as completedCount, answered_count as answeredCount, failed_count as failedCount, no_answer_count as noAnswerCount from ai_outbound_task order by task_id desc limit 20

select count(*) as totalAgents, ifnull(sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as onlineAgents, ifnull(sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as busyAgents from ai_call_agent_status

select ifnull(round(avg(case when satisfaction = '1' then 100 when satisfaction = '2' then 80 when satisfaction = '3' then 60 when satisfaction = '4' then 20 else null end), 0), 0) as avgSatisfaction from ai_call_ledger where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= #{beginTime} and create_time < #{endTime}
